description: This file defines a scheduler component for managing priority queues of model inference requests, utilizing in-memory and Redis caching. It includes classes for cache keys, flow items with priority, and the main Scheduler class with methods for adding requests, polling, peeking, and managing queues.

classes.name: SchedulerCacheKeys
classes.description: Enumeration of cache key constants used by the scheduler.

classes.name: FlowItem
classes.description: A data model representing a request with priority, request ID, and model name.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Main class for managing priority-based request queues with support for caching, polling, and queue inspection.

methods.name: __init__( self, polling_interval: Optional[float] = None, redis_cache: Optional[RedisCache] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler with optional polling interval and Redis cache.

methods.name: add_request(self, request: FlowItem)
methods.description: Adds a request to the queue based on its priority.

methods.name: bool poll(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)
methods.description: Checks if a request can be processed, optionally removing it if at the top and health is available.

methods.name: bool peek(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)
methods.description: Checks if a request is at the top of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: get_queue_status(self)
methods.description: Returns the current in-memory queue status.

methods.name: list get_queue(self, model_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the queue for a specific model from cache or in-memory.

methods.name: None save_queue(self, queue: list, model_name: str)
methods.description: Saves the updated queue to cache.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, polling_interval: Optional[float] = None, redis_cache: Optional[RedisCache] = None, )

ctags.name: get_queue
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_queue(self, model_name: str) -> list:$/

ctags.name: peek
ctags.pattern: /^    async def peek(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)

ctags.name: poll
ctags.pattern: /^    async def poll(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)

ctags.name: save_queue
ctags.pattern: /^    async def save_queue(self, queue: list, model_name: str) -> None:$/
